Detective Xenon asked me to help.
I can't say for certain yet, but...
Something is happening to the forest's ecosystem.
It seems like an ominous sign...
It must be more than you can handle on your own, Usher.
That's why I asked for help.
strings.그러니까, 저는 숲을 조사하면 되는 건가요?: So you want me to investigate the forest?
strings.숲이 이상해진 원인도 찾아보면 더 좋고…?: And if I can find out what's causing the changes, even better...?
I do have a suspicion, but nothing certain...
Actually, we're investigating sites around the world at the request of the Jiendia imperial court.
Dimensional rifts have been opening unpredictably, and they asked us to find the cause.
strings.설마 이리스와 관련이 있는 건가요?: Could this have something to do with Iris?
They appear to connect to the demon realm, or perhaps another world...
It certainly can't be anywhere good.
The energy leaking through the rifts is changing our ecosystem.
Anyway, now that I understand the situation...
I'll head back in and investigate thoroughly.
strings.오염 지역에서 가장 강한 생명체가 차원의 틈 부근을 장악하고 있다는 것이: Is that the strongest creature in each corrupted area has taken control of the area around the dimensional rift.
strings.기운을 독차지하기 위해서인가요?: To keep all the energy for itself?
Yes. The energy may be tainted, but absorbing it does make them stronger.
I'll head back into the forest.
It really is just a narrow rift, so it will be difficult to spot.
Try looking for the strongest monster, or one that has undergone an abnormal mutation.
I've been looking, but it's not easy.
Still, I feel like I'll find something if I search a little longer...
I'll go back in and keep searching until I find something.
I'm so glad you returned safely.
I was worried. I waited and waited, but there was no word from you.
I did find and defeat an abnormal monster, but...
Hmm. Somehow, I never saw the rift.
Still, I got rid of everything that looked dangerous.
Take someone who can perform purification rites and search the area.
I see. Thank you so much.
It must have been a difficult request...
Just a bit of a warm-up... Anyway, I have business elsewhere, so I'll be going.
Contact me anytime if there's a problem.
Take care of yourself until we meet again.
